summary: SunPower Inc. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that director Jamie Haenggi will not stand for reelection at the 2026 Annual Meeting, with no disagreement cited. The company set the virtual 2026 Annual Meeting for November 2, 2026, with a record date of September 18, 2026. Because the meeting is delayed more than 30 days from the 2025 anniversary, Rule 14a-5(f) notice is given, and nomination deadlines are reset. No deal, stake, or financial terms are stated; no advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch for the definitive proxy and any updated nomination windows.
